component.name: Mouse Battery
component.summary: Show your Logitech mouse battery in the system tray

description.p: Mouse Battery puts the battery level of every connected Logitech mouse in the system tray, and warns once at 10% and once at 5% per charge.

Clicking the tray icon opens a battery window with a level chart over the last day, week, or month, how many hours a charge lasts and how fast it charges month by month, and a health line that says when a charge lasts 15% less or charging takes 15% longer than it used to.

It reads mice the kernel drives through UPower, and reads other Logitech receivers and cables, such as the PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE's, through a small system service that offers only battery readings and each mouse's saved history. It isn't affiliated with Logitech.
